info.title: Features Service API
info.description:
Manages feature definitions and computes output stats.

Features are a minimal lookup table: id, slug, name, description, status.
Stats are computed by calling downstream services and aggregating results.

get.description: Returns features filtered by status. Defaults to `status=active`.

post.summary: Pre-fill feature inputs from brand data
post.description: Calls brand-service to extract field values for the feature's inputs. Returns pre-filled values keyed by input key. Requires x-brand-id header. Use ?format=text for flattened strings, ?format=full for structured values with per-brand breakdown.

schema.description: Response format: 'text' returns flattened strings, 'full' returns structured values with per-brand breakdown. Defaults to 'full'.
